Summary
I have outlined rental options for a standard sedan at San Francisco International Airport (SFO) for your trip from December 1 to December 5, 2024. The estimated duration is 4 days. A budget of $300 allows for approximately $75 per day including taxes and fees, which is feasible for standard or intermediate classes depending on current demand.

Assumptions
I have assumed the primary driver is at least 25 years old to avoid young driver surcharges and holds a valid credit card for the security deposit. I also assumed you are a US resident returning the car to the same location.

Structured Details
Option 1: Budget Rent A Car | Value-oriented agency often offering lower rates | Est. Total: $270 - $300
Action: [Button: Check Rates at Budget] https://www.budget.com/en/locations/us/ca/san-francisco/sfo

Option 2: Hertz | Wide selection with loyalty rewards | Est. Total: $290 - $320
Action: [Button: Check Rates at Hertz] https://www.hertz.com/rentacar/location/unitedstates/california/sanfrancisco/SFO

Option 3: Enterprise Rent-A-Car | Known for customer service and vehicle quality | Est. Total: $300 - $340
Action: [Button: Check Rates at Enterprise] https://www.enterprise.com/en/car-rental/locations/us/ca/san-francisco-international-airport-2316.html

Option 4: Kayak (Aggregator) | Compare all agencies to find the lowest price | Best for strict budget adherence
Action: [Button: Compare on Kayak] https://www.kayak.com/cars/SFO-a13852/2024-12-01/2024-12-05

Option 5: Turo | Peer-to-peer car sharing marketplace | Diverse vehicle options
